name: Balaybalan
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Koç, Mustafa. 2005. Bâleybelen Muhyî-i Gülşenî: ilk yapma dil (edition of the 1580 constructed language); Häberl, Charles G. 2015. Bālaybalan language (encyclopedia entry). Neither accessible online; stress plausibly covered only in Koç's edition.

sources.citation: Haşimoğlu, Ahmed Remzi. 2015. Baleybelen Elifbası: Baleybelen öğrenmenin kolay yolu. Self-published 7-page alphabet primer (archive.org item BaleybelenElifbas).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Only letter shapes, letter names, places of articulation (mahreç) and the reading values of fetha/kesra/damme/şedde (a/e, ı/i, u/ü, gemination). Amateur primer, not a descriptive source.

sources.citation: Häberl, Charles G. n.d. [draft 2015]. "Bālaybalan language". Encyclopaedia Iranica online. Sections: Origin and history of scholarship; Description of the dictionary; Phonology; Morphology; Noun phrase; Pronouns; Verb phrase; Syntax; Lexicon.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The Phonology section (read in full) covers six vowels (three tense/long vs three lax/short plus diphthongs), 33 consonants, five syllable types CV/CVV/CVC/CVVC/CVCC, the ban on initial clusters, glottal-stop elision and vowel syncope under affixation; it states twice that 'the manuscript offers no direct indication' of pronunciation. The words stress/accent/prominence do not occur anywhere in the article.

sources.citation: Koç, Mustafa. 2008. "Bilim tarihinin ilk yapma dili Bâleybelen". In 38. ICANAS (Uluslararası Asya ve Kuzey Afrika Çalışmaları Kongresi, Ankara 10-15 Eylül 2007), Bildiriler: Felsefe. Ankara: Atatürk Kültür, Dil ve Tarih Yüksek Kurumu, pp. 269-279.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. p. 275 enumerates the phonology (ses yapısı) chapters extracted from the Bâleybelen treatises in his 2005 edition: 'Ünsüz Düşmesi (Tek Ünsüz Düşmesi, Tekleşme), Ünlü Düşmesi (Kelime Başında / Ortasında / Sonunda Ünlü Düşmesi), Hece Binişmesi, Ünlü Değişmesi (Kısalma, Tekleşme ve Uzama), Ünsüz Değişmesi, Ses Dönüşmesi, Ses Türemesi (Ünsüz Türemesi, Ünlü Türemesi)' — consonant/vowel loss, syllable merger, vowel/consonant change, epenthesis. No vurgu (stress) heading; the word vurgu does not occur in the paper.

sources.note: Critical edition of all the Bâleybelen treatises with an extracted grammar (ses bilgisi, yapı bilgisi, söz dizimi) and 8,000-entry dictionary; the primary description. Its phonology chapter list (as summarised by Koç 2008) has no stress heading, but only the book itself can confirm silence.
